priority_order.human_impact: A mobile user loses access to a public chart and receives a generic 404 rather than a supported-state explanation.
priority_order.repair: Serve the same public chart or route to an explicit supported mobile chart while preserving the symbol.

priority_order.human_impact: The first meaningful mobile content is delayed by several seconds, increasing abandonment and obscuring whether the page is working.
priority_order.repair: Expose the exact responsive LCP image in initial HTML and prioritize only the selected mobile resource.

priority_order.human_impact: A mobile user pays network and battery cost for a 346800-byte image that is never visible.
priority_order.repair: Prevent the hidden responsive branch from initiating the image request.

priority_order.human_impact: The user sees no confirmed visible break, but the product creates avoidable request and diagnostic noise.
priority_order.repair: Remove or correct the obsolete first-party asset reference.

seven_petals.note: Confirmed findings, passed checks, hypotheses, and unknowns are separated; Tradernet currently gives mobile chart users an unclear generic 404.
Every confirmed finding is bound to an exact workflow run and artifact digest.
User-agent routing and late image discovery are causally isolated; one shared mobile branch remains a bounded hypothesis.
The CML pack preserves the cluster without approving an external report or asserting the hypothesis as fact.
Only public unauthenticated evidence is included; no private account, portfolio, or order data is stored.
Each finding includes a bounded repair path and avoids security or blame claims.
An authorized human decides whether and how to contact Tradernet, submit reports, or prioritize fixes.

unknowns: Live quote freshness, reconnect, and cross-surface consistency require a market-open experiment.
The shared mobile device-routing or responsive-resource cause is not proven.
The render-context console error has no established user impact.
Minute interval labels need visible-menu evidence.
